parsed.explanation: Active same-sex criminalisation is not trans-specific, but it is enforced and has been used as a lever against LGBT people, including border arrests; the 2026 amendment explicitly names "transsexuality" in a promotion/support ban. Documented anti-LGBT violence is severe, including a man's body exhumed and burned after outing, and historical disinterment of gender-diverse dead, with no hate-crime recourse or anti-discrimination protection. Trans people are described as facing prosecution, arrest, discrimination and violence, while local groups keep low profiles. No universal trans facility ban or border marker-screening rule is documented; missing LGR and domestic protections are resident-facing. Custody/border treatment is thin but extrapolates adversely from the enforcement climate. Enforcement clusters in the capital and at borders.
